shared_elements: head or face at top of the composition
circular disc/boss on the chest area
paired hands with splayed fingers meeting near the centre
wing-like or flanking lateral projections from the shoulders
justification: Both present a rigidly frontal, symmetrical standing figure organised in the same vertical order: head on top, banded neck, chest disc(s), small hands with fingers meeting at the midline, banded waist and a flaring lower body, with lateral wing/arm masses framing the torso — a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference is the manner of rendering and medium: A is a heavily eroded, shallow incised relief on a monumental rough stone block with an abstract human head, while B is a crisp, outlined and colour-shaded drawing of a raptor-headed being with elaborately feathered wings.
